ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Permission.Bypass_Opportunity_Validation), OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Standard_Opportunity", RecordType.DeveloperName = "Framework_Parent_Opportunity" ), OR( ISPICKVAL(Type, "New Deal"), ISPICKVAL(Type, "Renewal"), ISPICKVAL(Type, "Cross-Sell/Upsell") ), OR( ISPICKVAL(Touch_Level__c, "High Touch"), ISPICKVAL(Touch_Level__c, "Medium Touch"), ISPICKVAL(Touch_Level__c, "Low Touch"), ISPICKVAL(Touch_Level__c, "No Touch") ), OR( ISPICKVAL(Business_Unit__c, "RIM"), ISPICKVAL(Business_Unit__c, "Digital"), ISPICKVAL(Business_Unit__c, "ALM") ), NOT(ISBLANK(IM_Booked_Date__c)), IM_Booked_Date__c > ADDMONTHS(CloseDate, 12) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The anticipated First Bill Date must be within 12 months of the Close Date.
